reviews.text: Good fun honestly. Can finish game in ~2h. Plasma girl is OP as hell. One small bug - if you win/finish the game and level up - it bugs out and you cannot exit/continue. Need the good old ALT+F4.

This is yet another Vampire Survivor style game. I really enjoy the graphics of this one, but unfortunately I would not recommend it at this time. The amount of weapons, power ups, and stages is very low. I've already completed everything I think the game has to offer in under 2 hours. Each run ends up feeling the same due to the lack of variety. The first level is actually the hardest level, from my experience, which is weird. There are no difficulty modifiers, so I can't make the game harder, and I find the game really easy. I thought it was difficult at first, but once you realize that weapons/items seem to scale exponentially, the game becomes a lot easier once you start investing in one thing at a time rather than spreading out too much. I also question weapon and item balance. The daggers seem really good whereas things like the two pet weapons seem pretty unremarkable. A leveled regen also makes you seem invincible. So for now, this is a not recommend. There's just not enough here. I love the style and hope it continues to grow, though.
Unbalanced mess. Too few skills to choose from. Some skills are totally useless (whip) and some are really OP. (laser.)

Cute aesthetics, solid early access foundation, successfully executing the easy to obsess over formula aka most important of all: fun 100% worth the price & very promising. Very small upgrade and ability arsenal, and too easy at the moment though. Hoping more is done for Idle Maku to blaze it's own trail & carve out it's own niche.

画风还行，但是实际游玩体验极差。感觉制作人想做偏硬核的游戏，但没把控好很多东西有待优化。一个爽游首先得让人足够爽才行。说几个目前个人比较反感的问题： 1、弹幕和怪物看不清，受伤体感无反馈，攻击也基本上只有声音反馈，比黎明前20分钟还累眼睛； 2、天赋会自动重置，每次打完一局都得手动点一次； 3、boss箱子打开竟然会让我3D眩晕？？？； 4、道具有时限，不捡起来会消失； 5、道具屏幕外掉落无指引，一转眼掉了也找不到； 以上是目前比较影响体验的问题，建议赶紧优化。一个爽游首先要做到足够爽才行。

This game is not idle, which I assumed was with "Idle" in the title. The difficulty is pretty high. What's worse is you buy an upgrade and you'd expect the next level to cost more, however, it makes everything else cost more too. That's just stupid. Not to mention the cost of the upgrades get kinda absurd. There is no reroll system either so you just get stuck with trash, A LOT. Best thing about this game is it's 3 bucks. I liked the way it looked, not trying to push graphics or anything, it was simple. Wish you could tone down the flashing bullets when there are several types and all over the place. The game just has a lot more horrible features than good features for a Vampire Survivor genre.
It's like vampire survivors with lolis!

Maku is yet another of literally hundreds of lazy amateur 2D retro pixel Vampire Survivors ripoffs infesting Steam and lowering the average quality of all video games everywhere. This one does have an element of top down brawling as well as you apparently get to make some attacks, but the quality here is still deplorably low. At least it's not an asset flip? (because the assets are so bad no self respecting asset creator would publish them). The game was abandoned roughly 5 months after launch and hasn't been updated in 9 months. It blew past the developers commitment to complete the game without any notification or admission of failure from the developer. The game will never be completed. From a technical perspective, the game doesn't meet basic minimum requirements that most PC gamers expect as standard. A choice was made to use obsolete, decades old retro pixel "art" as a substitute for contemporary PC graphics. It's unclear if this is due to lack of budget or talent, regardless, the overall visual quality of the game is extremely low as a result. While there are options to change the resolution for the game, all this does is scale up the simplistic 2D art assets used to make the game, which makes little or no difference to the graphics quality. Without any other substantial graphics tweaks, it's not possible for gamers to improve the lacklustre 2D visuals. The controls can't be customised, which will be an annoyance for many, but it can also render the game unplayable for differently-abled gamers, left handed gamers or gamers using AZERTY or other international keyboard layouts. These technical defects push this game below acceptable standards for any modern PC game. The poor quality of this game is reflected by how many people spent time with it. At the time of this review, SteamDB shows the all-time peak player number was only 10 players. This is a remarkably low number, and now, the only player activity occurs once or twice a month, presumably someone loading it up to see what it is then quickly uninstalling it. Considering there's over 120 million gamers on Steam and well over 100,000 games for gamers to choose from, the overwhelming lack of interest in this low quality game is to be expected. Another unethical act of this developer, knowing full well that this game is abandoned and they will never complete it, they are deliberately trying to scam gamers into buying it by offering it on discount and selling keys to the game from third party key resellers. It's impossible to "accidentally" discount a game. The developer looked at their abandoned game, and instead of doing the right thing and removing it from Steam, they instead doubled-down and tried to scam even more people into paying for it. Greedy, and completely unethical. Doing the wrong thing, on purpose, for money. This is not okay. So, should you buy this game? Is this one of the best of the 100,000+ games on Steam? Maku is relatively cheap at $2 USD, but it's not worth it. Given the defects and quality issues with the game, coupled with the unrealistic price, and the questionable ethical nature of the developer and/or their associates (as outlined above), this is impossible to recommend. This is also competing with over 11,000 free games available on Steam, many of them far better than this paid product. 有成就 没中文 Maku 抵御蜂群！ 《Maku》是一款上手即玩的弹幕地狱生存类游戏。探索各个世界，在成千上万的怪物中杀出一条血路，不断提升实力！ 反转弹幕地狱 直观的 “移动优先” 操控方式，让你能专注于躲避敌人、在敌群中穿梭，同时向蜂群开火。调整站位，配合射击模式与时机，实现伤害最大化。 强化升级！ 获取新武器与强化道具，打造强力 Build（角色养成搭配方案），尝试多样技能组合，以便在时间耗尽前击败世界 BOSS。沿途收集金币，解锁永久强化，为后续游戏进程助力。击败 BOSS、完成挑战，解锁新角色加入阵容，并前往难度逐步提升的新世界。 挑战难度递增！ 完成关卡与挑战，解锁考验技巧的挑战模式 ——“硬核模式” 与 “恶魔模式”。通过 “无尽模式” 与 “极速模式” 改变游戏体验。在 “无尽模式” 中，看看自己能存活多久，同时积累永久强化；在 “极速模式” 中，缩短游戏时长，考验反应能力。
Luv the art style, music, and gameplay! It makes me appreciate the bullet hell genre! <3

Got it today for 68 cents, it should've rightfully been 69 cents, but oh well missed opportunities. However, if I had paid the asking price of $2.99 I found it to be highly worth it. Easy to get into with a few minor bugs here and there nothing a restart doesn't fix. Remember it's only 68 cents, even at 2.99 you can forgive the shortfalls, I know I would. I will be playing this more. It has lots of potential, lots of mobs, but you feel you're accomplishing things on the first run.

I WOULD GIVE IT A MAYBE IF I COULD! Eehhhhhhh it's okay. I love the genre so I enjoyed the game but it's buggy and this is supposed to be a 1.0 release? Yeah idk about that. It needs more time in the oven. It's decent, I'd say 5/10 but the $0.68 prices kicks it up to a 6/10.

《Maku》是whelp开发并发行的一款带有弹幕元素的类吸血鬼幸存者游戏，游戏仅支持英文，不过大部分单词都比较简单，只要拥有一点点的词汇量就能游玩这款游戏。 游戏玩法与传统类吸血鬼幸存者游戏类似：操控角色在怪物之间游走、躲避怪物的近战/远程攻击、击败怪物获取经验球、收集经验球提升等级、在升级时选择随机的主动/被动buff、生存一段时间后BOSS会登场、在限定时间内击败BOSS就能顺利通关。 游戏共有8位可操作角色，6个关卡，5种难度供玩家游玩，开局只能游玩第1关的普通难度，通关后才能解锁下一关/本关的高难度，高难度包含无尽模式，整体的体量还算对得起价格。游戏包含全局天赋系统，玩家可以使用闯关时获得的点数来获得全局强化，但比较奇怪的是似乎每局游戏之后全局天赋会自动清零。 游戏默认情况下角色不会自动攻击，得玩家手动开启。数字键1对应自动攻击，数字键2对应自动瞄准，得依次按下1和2才能让角色自动攻击周围的敌人。不同角色的攻击方式、伤害、攻速等属性略有差异，每个角色都拥有1项独特能力，按R键就能使用角色的能力。 总的来说，《Maku》是一款质量还行、价格非常便宜、物有所值的类吸血鬼幸存者游戏，推荐喜欢类吸血鬼幸存者游戏的玩家入手。 [table][td]欢迎关注鉴赏家[url= https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45519015/]“无趣评测”[/url][/td][/table]

The game offers a solid challenge with its multiple modes. I appreciate the effort put into the design, but it still feels a bit rough around the edges at times.

Maku combines intuitive controls with engaging bullet hell mechanics. The challenge ramps up quickly, and the variety of weapons keeps each run fresh and exciting.
Maku offers an engaging bullet hell experience with intuitive controls and charming pixel art. The variety of challenge modes keeps it fresh, making each run enjoyable.
I find Maku to be a solid title in the genre. It combines unique mechanics with satisfying progression, though occasional bugs are noticeable. Still, it's worth the low price.
